description: Notelm v2.0 — Achieve 80%+ NotebookLM UX parity with tags, global search, export, suggested questions, summaries, conversation titles, and keyboard shortcuts

userStories.title: Extend notebook and chat metadata schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store tags on notebooks and title/pinned on conversations so frontend features can persist these values.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `tags: List[str]` with default [] to notebook metadata schema in backend/app/models/schemas.py
Add `title: Optional[str]` and `pinned: bool` fields to chat-related schemas
Update notebook create/update endpoints to accept and persist tags
Update frontend TypeScript types in frontend/src/types/index.ts to include new fields
Python imports succeed: python -c 'from app.models.schemas import NotebookResponse, ChatMessage'
TypeScript compilation passes: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Create global search index in ChromaDB
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a global ChromaDB collection indexing documents across all notebooks for cross-notebook search functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `global_search` ChromaDB collection in backend/app/database.py on app startup
Add documents to global index on upload (in documents.py router or embedder service) with notebook_id metadata
Remove documents from global index when deleted
Add startup migration that re-indexes all existing documents into global_search if collection is empty
Python imports succeed and app starts without errors

userStories.title: Tag management API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need CRUD API endpoints for notebook tags so users can create, list, filter, and delete tags.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/notebooks/{id} accepts {tags: [string]} in request body and persists to metadata
GET /api/notebooks supports ?tag=xxx query param, returns only notebooks containing that tag
GET /api/tags returns deduplicated list of all unique tags across all notebooks
DELETE /api/tags/{name} removes the specified tag from all notebooks that have it
Each endpoint returns proper error responses for invalid input (400) and not found (404)
Tags persist across app restarts (stored in notebook metadata JSON)

userStories.title: Global search API endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need an API that searches across all notebooks and returns results with notebook context.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/search?q=xxx&limit=10 queries the global_search ChromaDB collection
Each result includes: snippet (text), source (document filename), notebook_id, notebook_name
Results deduplicated by chunk content (same text in different notebooks = show both)
Returns empty array (not error) when query is empty or no results found
Response time under 2 seconds for up to 10K documents

userStories.title: Export conversation API
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need an API that exports a notebook's conversation history as formatted Markdown for download.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/chat/export/{notebook_id} returns Markdown string with all messages for that notebook
Markdown includes: notebook name as # title, date header, each message with role label (User:/Assistant:), citations rendered as [^1] footnotes with source references at bottom
Response header includes Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="notebook-name-conversation.md"
Returns 404 with error message if notebook has no conversations
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Export notebook API (ZIP package)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export an entire notebook as a downloadable ZIP package containing documents, conversations, and metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/notebooks/{id}/export returns a ZIP file via StreamingResponse

ZIP contains: README.md (notebook overview with name, date, document list, tags), conversation.md (full chat history), metadata.json (tags, dates, document metadata), and documents/ folder with original uploaded files
Use Python zipfile stdlib — do NOT write temp files to disk
Proper Content-Disposition header: attachment; filename="{notebook-name}-{date}.zip"
Returns 404 if notebook not found
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Suggested questions API
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need a configurable API that uses LLM to generate relevant starter questions based on notebook documents.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/chat/suggested-questions accepts {notebook_id} and returns {questions: [string]} (3-5 questions)
Questions are contextually relevant to uploaded documents — not generic (uses existing RAG pipeline to get document context first)
Returns generic starter questions when no documents uploaded: ['What can I learn from this notebook?', 'Summarize the key points', 'What are the main themes?']
Returns empty array if notebook has no documents and no conversations
Accepts optional {count: number} param (default 4, min 1, max 8)
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Summary generation API (document + notebook)
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need APIs to generate document-level and notebook-level summaries using LLM with caching.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/documents/{doc_id}/summarize generates a 2-3 paragraph summary of a single document using LLM
POST /api/notebooks/{notebook_id}/summarize generates an overview summary of all documents in the notebook
Both endpoints check for cached summary in metadata first — return cached version if exists (MD5 hash of document content as cache key)
Cache invalidated when document content changes (re-upload) or new documents added to notebook
Returns proper error when document/notebook not found (404)
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Auto-generate conversation titles
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the backend to auto-generate a title for each conversation from the first user message, with an option for LLM-enhanced titles.
acceptanceCriteria: When first user message is sent in a new conversation, backend auto-generates a title
Default method: smart truncation — take first 50 chars of first message, break at word boundary, append '…' if truncated
Title stored in conversation metadata (persisted in notebook data)
PATCH /api/notebooks/{id}/conversation/{conv_id}/title allows manual title edit
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Tag management UI in sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see, add, and filter tags on notebooks in the sidebar so I can organize my work.
acceptanceCriteria: Each notebook in Sidebar shows its tags as small colored chips below the notebook name
Click '+' icon on notebook row opens inline input to add a tag (autocomplete dropdown from existing tags fetched from GET /api/tags)
Click a tag chip to filter sidebar — only notebooks with that tag shown, active filter highlighted
Clear filter with '×' button on active tag chip, or 'All Notebooks' option
Empty state message when no notebooks match selected tag
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Global search UI with keyboard shortcut
userStories.description: As a user, I want a ⌘K search bar that finds content across all my notebooks with context-rich results.
acceptanceCriteria: Search bar triggered by ⌘K / Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut (modal or slide-down panel)
Typing performs debounced search (300ms) against GET /api/search?q=xxx
Results shown as list: snippet text (with match highlighting), source document name, notebook name
Clicking a result navigates to that notebook page
Empty state placeholder: 'Search all notebooks…'
Loading spinner during API request
'No results found' message when search returns empty
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Export conversation button in ChatPanel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export the current conversation as a Markdown file with one click from the chat panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Export button (download ↓ icon) visible in ChatPanel header area (top-right, next to existing controls)
Click triggers GET /api/chat/export/{notebook_id} and downloads the returned Markdown file
Filename auto-generated: {notebook-name}-conversation-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md
Toast notification: 'Conversation exported as Markdown' on success
Toast notification: 'No conversation to export' if chat is empty
Button has tooltip: 'Export conversation'
Button disabled state (grayed out) when conversation is empty
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Export notebook button in Sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export an entire notebook as a ZIP package from the sidebar context menu.
acceptanceCriteria: Export option added to notebook context menu (right-click or '…' menu on notebook row in Sidebar)
Click triggers GET /api/notebooks/{id}/export and downloads ZIP file
Filename: {notebook-name}-{YYYY-MM-DD}.zip
Toast notification: 'Preparing export…' → 'Notebook exported' on success
Toast notification: 'Export failed' on error
Menu item shows icon (📥 or similar) + 'Export notebook' label
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Suggested questions panel in chat area
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see AI-generated suggested questions when I open a notebook so I know what to ask about the content.
acceptanceCriteria: When chat area is empty (no messages yet), show suggested questions as clickable button cards below the input area
Questions fetched from POST /api/chat/suggested-questions on notebook load
Clicking a suggested question sends it as a user message
Questions disappear after first message is sent
Refresh icon button next to questions to regenerate new suggestions
Loading skeleton (3 pulsing placeholder cards) while questions are being generated
Section hidden when no documents uploaded in notebook (show empty state instead)
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Summary display cards for documents and notebooks
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see AI-generated summaries for documents and the overall notebook so I can quickly grasp content without reading everything.
acceptanceCriteria: In SourcePanel: each document row has expandable 'Summary' section (collapsed by default). Click to expand shows summary text with 'Generate Summary' button if none cached
In ChatPanel area (when empty): summary card showing notebook overview (all documents combined)
Summary text shows loading skeleton while generating
Once generated, summary persists — shown immediately on revisit (cached in backend)
'Regenerate' button to force-refresh summary
Expand/collapse with smooth animation (CSS transition)
Summary section hidden if no documents in notebook
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Conversation history panel with auto-titles
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my conversation history with auto-generated titles and switch between conversations easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversation history panel: collapsible sidebar section or dropdown in chat area showing past conversations
Each entry shows: auto-generated title (from US-009), date, message count (e.g., '5 messages')
Current conversation highlighted with accent color
Click any conversation to switch to it (load its messages)
Pin button (📌) on each conversation row — pinned conversations sort to top with pin icon
'New Conversation' button (+ icon) at top of panel — starts fresh conversation
Delete button (🗑) on hover — shows confirmation dialog before deleting
Empty state: 'No conversations yet. Start asking questions about your documents!'
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Keyboard shortcuts system
userStories.description: As a power user, I want keyboard shortcuts for common actions and a help dialog listing all shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: ⌘K / Ctrl+K: Open global search
⌘J / Ctrl+J: New conversation
⌘E / Ctrl+E: Export current conversation
⌘N / Ctrl+N: New notebook
⌘, / Ctrl+,: Open settings dialog
? (Shift+/): Show keyboard shortcuts help dialog (modal with table of all shortcuts)
Help dialog lists all shortcuts with key combination and description
Shortcuts detect OS: show ⌘ on Mac, Ctrl on Windows/Linux (use navigator.platform check)
Shortcuts only fire when not typing in an input/textarea
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Settings panel — AI feature toggles
userStories.description: As a user, I want to enable/disable LLM-powered features from the Settings dialog to control API costs.
acceptanceCriteria: SettingsDialog has new 'AI Features' section below existing settings
Toggle switches for: 'Suggested Questions' (off by default), 'Auto Summaries' (off by default), 'Smart Titles (LLM)' (off by default)
Toggles saved to localStorage under key 'notelm_ai_features'
UI respects toggle state: suggested questions hidden when off, summaries hidden when off, titles use basic truncation when LLM titles off
Each toggle has helper text showing estimated token cost: e.g., '~200 tokens per generation'
Toggles work without page refresh (React state + localStorage sync)
Existing settings (API keys, model selection) continue to work unchanged
TypeScript compilation passes
